title: The crown falls
speaker: X GOD
caption: The Regent fell.
But his weapon was still awake.
alt: The defeated Regent's broken crown lies on violet stone while a meteor launcher still glows red.

title: Earthior wasn't yours
speaker: X GOD
caption: Earthior wasn't yours to spend.
And you don't get the next world.
alt: X turns from the fallen crown toward the launch controls, holding his scorched worksheet.

title: Friends answer
speaker: KILLER KAI · RADIO
caption: I've found the feed. C has a way out.
We're getting everyone clear.
alt: Kai traces the launch circuit over radio while C opens an evacuation path.

title: I've got it
speaker: Z-GOD
caption: Keep moving.
I've got it.
alt: Z-God casually supports a huge broken arch so local creatures can escape while X cuts the weapon's elemental feed.

title: No more meteors
speaker: X GOD
caption: The launch went dark.
This world would get its tomorrow.
alt: The meteor weapon shuts down, leaving the unlaunched meteor secured in its cradle.

title: What remains
speaker: X GOD
caption: They took my world.
They don't get the next one.
alt: At dawn X draws a route to more survivors on the back of his scorched worksheet, with Z-God beside him.
